title: Transpose-odd operator chirality in co-moving multiplicative processes: exact tail-level structure and a detectability obstruction
summary: We ask whether transposition changes the stationary heavy tail of the co-moving recursion $\mathbf x_{t+1}=Q_tBQ_t^\top\mathbf x_t+Q_t\boldsymbolη_t$ in $d=3$. The model has independent Haar rotations, Gaussian body-frame noise with covariance $Σ$, and an explicit positive metric $\mathsf g$. The tail index $α_\star$ depends only on singular values, so $α_\star(B)=α_\star(B^\top)$. The structure theorem and polar-twist mechanism are unconditional.
